newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas unit wins new HK airport concession.
newsitem.headline: Havas unit wins new HK airport concession.

text.p: Havas Media Communication, a unit of Havas, said in a statement on Tuesday it had won the advertising concession for the new Hong Kong airport for a period of five years.
The airport, Chek Lap Kok, is due to open in April 1998.

The concession will allow Havas Media Communication unit Pearl & Dean to have 180 billboards in the airport, and would allow it to organise exhibitions and shows in the airport shopping centre, the statement said.
